figurative_meaning_bn: কথা দিলে রাখে, কথায় অটল এমন নির্ভরযোগ্য ব্যক্তি
figurative_meaning_en: A reliable person who keeps their promises and does not go back on their word
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এক কথার মানুষ, বললে অবশ্যই করে।
এক কথার মানুষ হিসেবে তার কথায় সবাই ভরসা করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a man of his word; if he says it, he will surely do it.
Everyone trusts him because he is true to his word.
note: This idiom emphasizes the cultural value of trustworthiness in Bengali society.
